note_zh: 第二阶段（proxy 补丁写出 session_id 之后）再用。来自 tar 59604f30 生成的看板，查询读 proxy 行 vllm_pd.request_summary。

panels.title: 各轮 P / D 耗时

targets.rawSql:
WITH s AS (SELECT * FROM vllm_pd.request_summary WHERE session_id = '${session_id}' ORDER BY ts LIMIT 1 BY request_id)
SELECT toString(row_number() OVER (ORDER BY s.ts)) AS "轮次", s.request_id AS request_id,
       if(s.p_total_ms > 0, ifNull(s.api_gateway_ms, 0)+ifNull(s.proxy_to_p_ms, 0) + s.p_total_ms, NULL) AS "P 合计", coalesce(d.start_load_kv_ms, d.start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms) AS "D 等 KV", ifNull(if(s.d_total_ms > 0, ifNull(s.proxy_to_d_ms, 0) + s.d_total_ms, NULL), 0) - ifNull(coalesce(d.start_load_kv_ms, d.start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms), 0) AS "D 其余"
FROM s LEFT JOIN (SELECT request_id, argMin(req_resolve_ms, t0) AS req_resolve_ms, argMin(tokenizer_ms, t0) AS tokenizer_ms, argMin(add_request_ms, t0) AS add_request_ms, argMin(schedule_ms, t0) AS schedule_ms, argMin(schedule__queue_time_ms, t0) AS schedule__queue_time_ms, argMin(schedule__alloc_ms, t0) AS schedule__alloc_ms, argMin(schedule__other_ms, t0) AS schedule__other_ms, argMin(start_load_kv_ms, t0) AS start_load_kv_ms, argMin(start_load_kv__submit_ms, t0) AS start_load_kv__submit_ms, argMin(start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms, t0) AS start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms, argMin(forward_ms, t0) AS forward_ms, argMin(sampling_ms, t0) AS sampling_ms, argMin(detokenizer_ms, t0) AS detokenizer_ms, sum(schedule_rest_ms) AS schedule_rest_ms, sum(schedule__alloc_rest_ms) AS schedule__alloc_rest_ms, sum(schedule__other_rest_ms) AS schedule__other_rest_ms, sum(forward_rest_ms) AS forward_rest_ms, sum(sampling_rest_ms) AS sampling_rest_ms, sum(detokenizer_rest_ms) AS detokenizer_rest_ms, sum(steps_rest) AS steps_rest, uniqExact(attempt_id) AS attempts, argMin(lines, t0) AS lines FROM (SELECT request_id, attempt_id, min(ts) AS t0, uniqExact(proc) AS lines, max(req_resolve_ms) AS req_resolve_ms, max(tokenizer_ms) AS tokenizer_ms, max(add_request_ms) AS add_request_ms, max(schedule_ms) AS schedule_ms, max(schedule__queue_time_ms) AS schedule__queue_time_ms, max(schedule__alloc_ms) AS schedule__alloc_ms, max(schedule__other_ms) AS schedule__other_ms, max(start_load_kv_ms) AS start_load_kv_ms, max(start_load_kv__submit_ms) AS start_load_kv__submit_ms, max(start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms) AS start_load_kv__wait_for_transfer_ms, max(forward_ms) AS forward_ms, max(sampling_ms) AS sampling_ms, max(detokenizer_ms) AS detokenizer_ms, max(schedule_rest_ms) AS schedule_rest_ms, max(schedule__alloc_rest_ms) AS schedule__alloc_rest_ms, max(schedule__other_rest_ms) AS schedule__other_rest_ms, max(forward_rest_ms) AS forward_rest_ms, max(sampling_rest_ms) AS sampling_rest_ms, max(detokenizer_rest_ms) AS detokenizer_rest_ms, max(steps_rest) AS steps_rest FROM vllm_pd.phase_line WHERE role = 'decode' AND request_id IN (SELECT request_id FROM s) GROUP BY request_id, attempt_id) GROUP BY request_id) AS d ON d.request_id = s.request_id
ORDER BY s.ts
